title: Registration trends
subtitle: When runners signed up for this event
noData: No registration timestamps recorded yet. Runners imported from Eventor and runners added manually after this update will appear here.
noComparisonEvents: No comparison events selected. Click "Add comparison events" to overlay similar events from Eventor.
comparisonHelp: Select comparable events from Eventor to overlay on the chart. Curves are aligned by days-before-race so different events are directly comparable.
noKeyConfigured: Connect an Eventor API key to enable comparison.
addByIdHeading: Add by Eventor event ID or URL
addByIdHelp: Paste an Eventor event ID (e.g. 12345) or a full URL like eventor.orientering.se/Events/Show/12345. Useful when you already know the event you want to compare against.
browseHelp: Search Eventor for events in a date window around your race. Curves on the chart are aligned by days-before-race so events with different start dates are directly comparable.
